#{tfCode}

select mtf.id, mtf.template_id, mtf.field_id, mtf.field_val, mtf.logic, mtf.relation, mtf.sort, mtf.field_code, mtf.table_code, mt.table_name, mt.is_loop isLoop, mt.primary_code primaryCode, mt.slave_type slaveType, mt.related_field relatedField, mt.main_table_code mainTableCode, mtfi.field_name, mtfi.data_type from cbdses_template_field mtf left join cbdses_table mt on mt.table_code = mtf.table_code left join cbdses_table_field mtfi on mtfi.field_code = mtf.field_code and mtfi.table_id = mt.id where template_id = #{templateId}
